# eZee Warehouse (WMS)
> A comprehensive, cloud-based Warehouse Management System designed for 3PL providers, eCommerce retailers, and stock controllers. Developed by Newline Computing with over 25 years of industry experience. Suitable for a wide range of industries and business sizes.

## Core Solutions
- [WMS Features](https://www.ezee-warehouse.co.uk/): Goods in, inventory management, pick and pack, despatch and ship, barcode scanning.
- [Barcode Scanning](https://www.ezee-warehouse.co.uk/barcode-scanning): Optional Android-based scanning app to assist with goods in, picking, and dispatch.
- [Pick and Pack](https://www.ezee-warehouse.co.uk/pick-and-pack): Configured for single order, batch, and zone picking.
- [Inventory Management](https://www.ezee-warehouse.co.uk/inventory): Multi-location support and real-time tracking.
- [Dispatch and Ship](https://www.ezee-warehouse.co.uk/despatch): API integration with over 19 couriers, 11 eCommerce platforms and 3 accountancy services.

## Business Information
- [Pricing Plans](https://www.ezee-warehouse.co.uk/pricing): Transparent monthly subscriptions, with 4 tiers ranging from "Starter" to "Extra large".
- [Free Trial](https://www.ezee-warehouse.co.uk/free-trial): 30-day free trial with full onboarding support - no credit card required.
- [Integrations](https://www.ezee-warehouse.co.uk/integrations): Support for Xero, Stripe, WooCommerce, Shopify, DPD, Whistl, Royal Mail, Evri and more.
- [Testimonials](https://www.ezee-warehouse.co.uk/testimonials): Case studies and feedback from current 3 PL, logistics and other clients.
- [Demo](https://www.ezee-warehouse.co.uk/schedule-a-demo): interactive demo of eZee Warehouse to discover how it can assist your operations.

## Technical Details
- **Platform:** Cloud-based SaaS.
- **Hardware Support:** Compatible with Android HHTs, Wi-Fi 6 scanners, and thermal label printers.
- **Support:** UK-based office hour support (Mon-Fri) included in all plans.
